_comment: Editable corpus for Lore's synastry reading. Read by SynastryInterpreter. Planet and point names must match the app's display names (Sun … Pluto, North Node, Chiron, Lilith, Ascendant, Midheaven). Edit any line to change the reading; a missing or empty line falls back to the building blocks below.
_aspects_comment: Bespoke lines keyed 'Point|Tone|Point' for a contact between one person's point and the other's. Tone is Conjunction, Flow (sextile or trine) or Tension (square or opposition). The two points are always in the app's standard order (Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, North Node, Chiron, Lilith, Ascendant, Midheaven), so there is one line per pair: 'Sun|Flow|Moon', never 'Moon|Flow|Sun'. In the text, {a} is the person who owns the first-named point and {b} the person who owns the second. Written as tendencies rather than predictions.

aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Sun: {a} and {b} share much the same outlook: they want similar things from life and recognise themselves in each other. The likeness is comfortable, though each can also mirror the other's blind spots.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Sun: Their basic natures are compatible. {a} and {b} tend to support each other's aims without needing to compete, and being themselves around each other takes little effort.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Sun: Two strong wills pulling in different directions. {a} and {b} can clash over whose way prevails, yet the difference also supplies what each lacks if they treat it as balance rather than a contest.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Moon: A classic bond: {a}'s identity sits right on {b}'s emotional centre. {b} feels instinctively at home with {a}, and {a} feels seen and supported. The two can seem made to fit.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Moon: {a}'s way of being suits {b}'s emotional needs. {b} feels comfortable and understood, {a} feels quietly backed, and daily life together tends to run without much friction.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Moon: {a}'s aims and {b}'s feelings pull in different ways. {b} may feel overlooked and {a} held back, but the attraction is real; it works when each makes room for what the other needs.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Mercury: {b} understands how {a} sees the world and can put it into words. Conversation comes easily, and {a} feels heard and taken seriously.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Mercury: They communicate well. {b}'s ideas support what {a} is trying to do, and talking things through tends to leave both clearer.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Mercury: {b}'s way of thinking can grate on {a}'s pride, and {a} may seem to talk over {b}. Misunderstandings are common but usually small; they ease once both listen as much as they speak.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Venus: Warm and affectionate. {b} simply likes who {a} is, and {a} feels appreciated; there is real pleasure in each other's company, and often shared taste.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Venus: An easy fondness. {b} finds {a} attractive and likeable, {a} enjoys being admired, and the two bring out each other's generous side.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Venus: There is attraction, but their tastes and ways of showing affection differ. {b} can feel taken for granted, or {a} flattered rather than known; small gestures matter more than usual.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Mars: High energy. {b} stirs {a} into action and {a} fires up {b}'s drive: exciting, physical and competitive. Good for doing things together, less so for sitting still.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Mars: They energise each other. {b} backs {a}'s goals with real effort, {a} gives {b}'s drive a direction, and working side by side comes naturally.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Mars: Sparks, of both kinds. {b}'s push meets {a}'s pride, and tempers can flare over who leads. The same heat makes for strong attraction if arguments are kept fair.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Jupiter: {b} makes {a} feel bigger. There is encouragement, generosity and good humour here, and the two tend to feel luckier together than apart.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Jupiter: A supportive, optimistic link. {b} believes in {a}, {a} lifts {b}'s spirits, and they give each other room to grow.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Jupiter: Plenty of goodwill, but also a tendency to overdo it: promising too much, spending too much, or {b} lecturing {a}. Enthusiasm needs an occasional reality check.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Saturn: A serious, binding tie. {b} steadies {a} and takes {a} seriously, which can feel like commitment or like criticism. It lasts when {b}'s caution leaves {a} room to shine.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Saturn: {b} offers {a} stability and practical support, and {a} brings warmth to {b}'s sense of duty. Reliable rather than dramatic; it builds trust over time.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Saturn: {a} can feel judged or restricted by {b}, while {b} sees {a} as careless or self-centred. The tie is durable but heavy; it needs encouragement said out loud.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Ascendant: {a}'s nature matches the way {b} meets the world. They are easily taken for a pair, and {a} feels immediately familiar to {b}.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Ascendant: {a} is at ease with how {b} comes across, and {b} feels more confident around {a}. First impressions were probably good and have stayed that way.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Ascendant: {a}'s nature runs across {b}'s way of meeting the world. They notice each other strongly: an opposition here often marks a natural partner, a square more of a clash of styles to work around.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Moon: They feel things the same way. Moods, needs and comforts line up so closely that each knows what the other is feeling without being told. Soothing, though moods can also be contagious.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Moon: Emotionally compatible. {a} and {b} have similar rhythms and find the same things comforting, which makes living alongside each other easy.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Moon: Different emotional habits. What settles {a} can unsettle {b}, and each may misread the other's moods. Patience with the other's way of coping does most of the work here.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Mercury: {b} can put {a}'s feelings into words, and {a} senses what {b} means. They talk easily about personal things.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Mercury: Feelings and words cooperate. {a} feels listened to, {b} feels understood, and everyday conversation is relaxed.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Mercury: {b} analyses when {a} wants sympathy, and {a} reacts when {b} wants to reason. Each can feel unheard; it helps to ask which is wanted, comfort or solutions.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Venus: Tender and affectionate. {a} feels cared for by {b}, {b} feels emotionally welcomed by {a}, and there is real sweetness and domestic ease between them.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Venus: Gentle mutual affection. They are kind to each other by habit, enjoy similar comforts, and tend to make a pleasant home of wherever they are.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Venus: Affection is there, but {b}'s way of showing love does not always meet {a}'s emotional needs. One may feel smothered or the other neglected; it helps to say plainly what feels like care.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Mars: {b} stirs {a}'s feelings directly: passionate and protective, but also quick to irritate. Emotions run close to the surface whenever they are together.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Mars: {b}'s energy warms {a} rather than overwhelming, and {a}'s feelings motivate {b}. There is a lively, mutually protective attraction.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Mars: {b}'s bluntness can hurt {a}, and {a}'s moods can provoke {b}. Strong chemistry and frequent flare-ups go together; arguments need to end before they wound.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Jupiter: {b} is generous with {a}'s feelings: {a} feels safe, indulged and cheered up. There is warmth and easy trust, and they are kind to each other.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Jupiter: A good-natured, comforting link. {b} lifts {a}'s moods, {a} makes {b} feel welcome, and they forgive each other readily.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Jupiter: Well meant but excessive. {b} may promise more than is delivered or wave away {a}'s worries, and feelings get exaggerated. The kindness is real; follow-through matters.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Saturn: {b} gives {a}'s emotional life structure: dependable and lasting, yet {a} can feel held at arm's length. It deepens if {b} shows warmth as well as responsibility.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Saturn: {b} is steady where {a} is sensitive, and {a} softens {b}'s reserve. A quiet loyalty grows here, built on being able to count on each other.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Saturn: {a} may feel criticised or emotionally shut out by {b}, and {b} burdened by {a}'s needs. The bond can be long-lasting but lonely unless reassurance is given freely.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Ascendant: {a} feels instantly comfortable with {b}'s manner, and {b} senses {a}'s moods. There is a homely familiarity, as though they had known each other for years.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Ascendant: {b}'s way of meeting the world puts {a} at ease, and {a} responds warmly. They are relaxed in each other's company.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Ascendant: {a}'s moods and {b}'s outward manner do not always match. In opposition, {a} may be just what {b} looks for in a partner; in square, {b}'s style can jar on {a}'s feelings.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Mercury: They think alike. Similar humour, similar interests, and conversations that pick up where they left off.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Mercury: Their minds work well together. They explain things in ways the other follows, and enjoy exchanging ideas.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Mercury: They think and talk in different styles: one quick and one careful, or one literal and one loose. Arguments about wording are common, though between them they cover more ground.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Venus: Pleasant conversation and shared tastes. {a} says things {b} likes to hear, and {b} makes {a}'s ideas feel welcome.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Venus: They enjoy talking to each other. Compliments come easily, disagreements stay polite, and they share interests in art, music or ideas.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Venus: {a} can sound critical when {b} wants warmth, and {b} can seem to prefer pleasantness to plain speaking. A minor friction, but tact and honesty need balancing.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Mars: Fast, lively exchange. {b} sharpens {a}'s thinking and {a} gives {b}'s impulses a plan. Stimulating, and prone to heated debate.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Mars: {b} turns {a}'s ideas into action, and {a} helps {b} think before acting. They make an effective team and enjoy a good argument.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Mars: Words turn sharp. {b} can be impatient with {a}'s talk, {a} can needle {b}, and discussions escalate into quarrels. Slowing down before replying helps a great deal.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Jupiter: Big conversations. {b} widens {a}'s thinking and {a} gives {b}'s ideas detail. They learn from each other and rarely run out of things to discuss.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Jupiter: A mentally generous link. They encourage each other's plans, share a sense of humour, and enjoy study, travel or debate together.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Jupiter: {b} sees the big picture and {a} the details, and each can find the other careless or petty. Plans get over-promised, so it is worth writing things down.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Saturn: {b} gives {a}'s thinking discipline and depth, and takes {a}'s ideas seriously. Good for practical planning, though {a} may feel corrected.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Saturn: {b} offers sound advice and {a} helps {b} see alternatives. Conversations are sensible and productive, and plans made together tend to hold.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Saturn: {a} can feel criticised or dismissed by {b}, and {b} finds {a} unreliable or scattered. Communication becomes guarded; it loosens when {b} listens without correcting.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Ascendant: {a} finds {b} easy to talk to from the first meeting, and has a good read on how {b} presents to the world.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Ascendant: Conversation flows. {a} understands {b}'s manner, and {b} feels free to speak openly.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Ascendant: {a}'s way of putting things can rub against {b}'s style or, in opposition, make {a} the person {b} most likes to talk things over with.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Venus: They love in the same way and like the same things. Shared taste, shared pleasures, and an easy agreement about what makes life good.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Venus: Their affections and values are compatible. They enjoy each other's company and rarely argue over money, style or how to spend free time.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Venus: Different tastes, and different ways of showing love. What one finds romantic the other may find excessive or cool. Nothing serious, but it takes some give and take.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Mars: The classic sign of attraction. {a}'s charm and {b}'s desire meet directly: magnetic, romantic and physical, and hard for either to ignore.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Mars: Attraction that works smoothly. {b} pursues in a way {a} enjoys, {a} responds in a way that encourages {b}, and affection and desire stay in step.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Mars: Strong chemistry with friction built in. {b} can come on too strong or {a} seem to tease, and desire and affection fall out of step. Exciting, but it needs consideration.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Jupiter: Generous and happy. They enjoy life together, spoil each other, and bring out each other's warmth. One of the most pleasant contacts two charts can share.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Jupiter: Kindness flows both ways. {b} is generous to {a}, {a} is affectionate to {b}, and they tend to have fun and good fortune together.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Jupiter: Enjoyable but indulgent. They encourage each other to overspend, overeat or overpromise. The goodwill is real; restraint is the missing ingredient.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Saturn: Loyal and lasting. {b} takes {a}'s affection seriously and offers commitment, though {a} may wish for more warmth. Love shown as dependability.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Saturn: {b} gives {a}'s affections a secure base, and {a} softens {b}. Devotion grows steadily, and the bond tends to endure.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Saturn: {a} can feel unloved or held back by {b}'s reserve, while {b} doubts {a}'s seriousness. Duty outweighs pleasure unless affection is deliberately shown.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Ascendant: {a} is drawn to how {b} looks and acts, and {b} feels liked and at ease around {a}. An immediate, mutual attraction.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Ascendant: They find each other pleasant and attractive. {a} is charming toward {b}, and {b}'s manner brings out {a}'s affection.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Ascendant: There is attraction, especially in opposition, where {a} is much what {b} wants in a partner. In square, their social styles and tastes can differ.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Mars: They act alike and want things with the same intensity. A strong team when aimed at the same goal; rivals when not.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Mars: Their energies cooperate. They work, play and compete well together, and neither has to slow down for the other.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Mars: Their ways of acting collide. One pushes when the other pulls, tempers meet head-on, and competition can sour. Shared physical activity is a good outlet.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Jupiter: {b} enlarges {a}'s drive: enterprise, adventure and confidence. Together they take on more than either would alone.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Jupiter: They encourage each other to act. {b} gives {a}'s efforts luck and backing, and {a} gets {b}'s plans moving.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Jupiter: They egg each other on. Risks get bigger, effort gets scattered, and neither says stop. Good-natured, but someone has to count the cost.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Saturn: Drive meets control. {b} can steady and direct {a}'s energy or simply block it, and {a} can spur {b} or just irritate. Productive if roles are agreed.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Saturn: {b} gives {a}'s efforts discipline and staying power, and {a} gets {b} moving. Together they finish what they start.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Saturn: Accelerator and brake. {a} feels thwarted by {b}'s caution, {b} feels pushed by {a}'s impatience, and resentment can build. It helps to agree on pace before starting anything.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Ascendant: {a} is energised by {b}'s presence and acts on it: attraction, competition or both. {b} is rarely indifferent to {a}.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Ascendant: {a} motivates {b}, and {b}'s manner channels {a}'s energy well. They enjoy doing things together.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Ascendant: {a} can come across to {b} as pushy or provoking; in opposition this is also strong attraction. A lively contact that needs fair fighting.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Jupiter: They share beliefs, hopes and a sense of what life is for. This is common between people of the same age, or twelve years apart.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Jupiter: Their outlooks are compatible. They agree broadly on what matters and encourage each other's ambitions.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Jupiter: They differ in beliefs, or in what they call a good life. Rarely a serious problem, but worth some respect when the subject is religion, politics or money.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Saturn: {a}'s optimism meets {b}'s caution. Well handled, it is a sound working balance of vision and realism; badly handled, {a} feels dampened.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Saturn: {a} supplies hope and {b} supplies structure. Good for building something practical together: a business, a household, a plan.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Saturn: {a} wants to expand and {b} wants to hold back. Each can see the other as reckless or as a wet blanket; decisions need compromise on timing.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Ascendant: {a} is generous and encouraging toward {b}, and {b} feels more confident for it. A friendly, good-humoured contact.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Ascendant: {a} sees the best in {b}, and {b}'s manner cheers {a}. They are good company for each other.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Ascendant: {a} means well but can overwhelm {b} or promise too much; in opposition, {a} is often a benefactor or a welcome partner.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Saturn: They are at the same stage of life's responsibilities (the same age, or a Saturn cycle apart) and understand each other's fears and duties.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Saturn: Their approaches to duty and security fit together. They can rely on each other in practical matters.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Saturn: They carry different fears and different ideas of responsibility, as people about seven years apart often do. Each may think the other worries about the wrong things.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Ascendant: {a} takes {b} seriously and can be a steadying influence or a critical one. {b} feels a sense of obligation around {a}.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Ascendant: {a} is a reliable presence for {b}, and {b} respects {a}'s experience. A stabilising, long-term contact.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Ascendant: {b} can feel judged or weighed down by {a}; in opposition the tie is often a lasting commitment with duties attached.
aspects.Ascendant|Conjunction|Ascendant: They meet the world in the same way and seem alike to others. Easy mutual understanding of style and habit.
aspects.Ascendant|Flow|Ascendant: Their outward styles are compatible. They are comfortable being seen together and go about things in ways that fit.
aspects.Ascendant|Tension|Ascendant: In opposition, each one's manner is what the other looks for in a partner: a natural pairing. In square, their styles and habits get in each other's way.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Uranus: {b} is exciting and unsettling for {a}: a jolt that makes {a} feel freer and more original. Rarely dull; not always stable.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Uranus: {b} brings freshness and encourages {a}'s independence, and {a} appreciates {b}'s individuality. Stimulating, with room to breathe.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Uranus: Attraction with an on-off quality. {b} can be unpredictable or distant just when {a} wants consistency. It needs plenty of freedom to last.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Neptune: {b} idealises {a}, and {a} feels something romantic or inspiring in {b}. Deep sympathy is possible; so is seeing what one wishes to see.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Neptune: A gentle, imaginative link. {b} is sympathetic to {a}, and they share ideals, creativity or faith.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Neptune: Illusion and confusion. {b} may be evasive, or {a} may not see {b} clearly, and disappointment follows from unspoken expectations. Things are best stated plainly.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Pluto: Intense. {b} has a powerful effect on {a}: fascination, deep change, and sometimes a struggle over control. Not a casual connection.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Pluto: {b} strengthens {a} and helps {a} change for the better. There is depth and loyalty without the power struggles.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Pluto: A contest of wills. {b} may try to control or remake {a}, and {a} resists. Compelling and hard to leave alone; it needs honesty about power.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Uranus: {b} stirs up {a}'s feelings: exciting, but unsettling for {a}'s need for security. Emotional life with {b} is never routine.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Uranus: {b} brings liveliness to {a}'s emotional life, and {a} accepts {b}'s need for space. Friendly and stimulating.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Uranus: {a} wants closeness when {b} wants freedom. {b}'s unpredictability makes {a} anxious, and {a}'s needs make {b} restless. Reliability in small things helps.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Neptune: Almost wordless sympathy. {a} and {b} pick up each other's feelings without being told: tender and dreamy, with a risk of blurred boundaries.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Neptune: Compassionate and gentle. {b} soothes {a}, {a} trusts {b}, and they share imagination and quiet understanding.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Neptune: Feelings are easily misread. {b} may be vague or evasive, {a} over-sensitive, and each imagines what the other feels. Assumptions are worth checking, kindly.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Pluto: Emotionally consuming. {b} reaches the deepest layer of {a}'s feelings; the bond is intense and private, and can become possessive.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Pluto: Deep emotional trust. {b} helps {a} face and release old feelings, and {a} gives {b} a safe place. Strong, quiet loyalty.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Pluto: Emotional power struggles. {b} can be controlling or jealous, {a} can feel overwhelmed, and feelings get used as leverage. It needs space and straight dealing.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden, electric attraction. {b} excites {a} and breaks {a}'s usual pattern in love. Thrilling; steadiness is not its strong point.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Uranus: Fresh and fun. {b} keeps things interesting for {a}, and they give each other freedom without feeling less close.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Uranus: Attraction that blows hot and cold. {b} resists being tied down, and {a} feels unsure where things stand. It works best with independence on both sides.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Neptune: Highly romantic. {a} and {b} see something ideal in each other: tender and inspiring, though the real person has to be loved too.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Neptune: A gentle, romantic sympathy. They share artistic or spiritual tastes and treat each other with kindness.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Neptune: Romance clouded by wishful thinking. One may put the other on a pedestal or avoid hard truths, and disappointment can follow. Honesty protects the tenderness.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Pluto: Magnetic and all-absorbing. {b} is powerfully drawn to {a}, and {a} feels deeply desired. Passion runs high; so can jealousy.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Pluto: Deep, lasting attraction. Affection has intensity without the possessiveness, and the relationship changes both for the better.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Pluto: Passion with a possessive edge. {b} may try to hold {a} too tightly, and love gets tangled with control or jealousy. It needs trust given freely.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Uranus: Explosive energy. They excite and provoke each other, act on impulse together, and can clash just as suddenly.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Uranus: They spark each other into action. Inventive and adventurous together, with room for each to do things their own way.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Uranus: Volatile. Neither takes orders from the other, tempers flash without warning, and plans change abruptly. Space helps when either is irritated.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Neptune: {b} inspires or confuses {a}'s drive. Shared ideals can motivate {a}; vagueness from {b} can leave {a} unsure what to act on.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Neptune: {b}'s imagination gives {a}'s efforts a purpose, and {a} helps make {b}'s dreams practical. Good for creative or charitable work.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Neptune: {a}'s directness meets {b}'s evasiveness. {a} feels undermined and {b} feels pushed, and motives get misread. It helps to be explicit about what each wants.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Pluto: Great force, for good or ill. Together they can move mountains or lock horns; desire and willpower are both magnified.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Pluto: They strengthen each other's resolve. Formidable when working toward the same end, with strong physical attraction.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Pluto: A power struggle. Each tries to prevail, anger runs deep, and neither backs down easily. It needs clear limits and a refusal to fight dirty.

_blocks_comment: Building blocks for any pair without a bespoke line: "Anna's <pointTheme> <toneLink> Ben's <pointTheme>."
_elements_comment: The two Sun signs (and Moon signs) compared by element, keyed 'Element|Element' in the order Fire, Earth, Air, Water. {a} is the person with the first-named element, {b} the second.

sunElements.Fire|Fire: Two fire Suns: both are direct, enthusiastic and keen to act. They spur each other on and rarely bore each other, though someone has to supply the patience.
sunElements.Fire|Earth: {a}'s fire Sun wants to move; {b}'s earth Sun wants to build. {a} brings spark and {b} brings staying power, which is useful as long as {a} does not feel slowed and {b} rushed.
sunElements.Fire|Air: Fire and air feed each other. {b}'s ideas fan {a}'s enthusiasm, {a} puts {b}'s ideas into motion, and the two keep each other interested.
sunElements.Fire|Water: {a}'s fire Sun acts on impulse; {b}'s water Sun acts on feeling. There is warmth and intensity here, but {a} can seem careless of feelings and {b} dampening.
sunElements.Earth|Earth: Two earth Suns: practical, steady and concerned with what is real. They understand each other's need for security and build well together, at some risk of routine.
sunElements.Earth|Air: {a}'s earth Sun deals in facts and results; {b}'s air Sun deals in ideas and talk. Each offers what the other lacks, once {a} stops finding {b} impractical and {b} stops finding {a} stolid.
sunElements.Earth|Water: Earth and water nourish each other. {a} gives {b} steadiness, {b} gives {a} emotional depth, and they tend to feel safe together.
sunElements.Air|Air: Two air Suns: talkative, curious and sociable. They are friends as much as anything else, and need to remember that feelings also want attention.
sunElements.Air|Water: {a}'s air Sun reasons; {b}'s water Sun feels. {a} can seem detached to {b}, and {b} moody to {a}, but together they cover both head and heart.
sunElements.Water|Water: Two water Suns: sensitive, intuitive and private. They understand each other without much explanation, and can also sink into each other's moods.

moonElements.Fire|Fire: Both Moons are in fire: feelings are quick, warm and openly shown. Upsets blow up fast and blow over fast.
moonElements.Fire|Earth: {a}'s fire Moon reacts at once; {b}'s earth Moon wants calm and routine. {a} may find {b} unresponsive and {b} find {a} dramatic, though each can steady or enliven the other.
moonElements.Fire|Air: {a}'s fire Moon and {b}'s air Moon get on easily: both like stimulation and talk, and neither clings. Feelings are aired rather than brooded on.
moonElements.Fire|Water: {a}'s fire Moon wants to express a feeling and move on; {b}'s water Moon wants to feel it through. {b} can be hurt by {a}'s haste, and {a} wearied by {b}'s depth.
moonElements.Earth|Earth: Both Moons are in earth: comfort comes from stability, routine and tangible care. A calm, dependable emotional climate.
moonElements.Earth|Air: {a}'s earth Moon is soothed by practical things; {b}'s air Moon by talking it over. They can miss each other's cues until each learns the other's kind of comfort.
moonElements.Earth|Water: {a}'s earth Moon and {b}'s water Moon suit each other: {a} offers security, {b} offers tenderness, and both value a settled home life.
moonElements.Air|Air: Both Moons are in air: feelings are dealt with by talking and thinking. Light and companionable, sometimes at a distance from deeper emotion.
moonElements.Air|Water: {a}'s air Moon steps back to think; {b}'s water Moon wants closeness. {b} can feel kept at a distance and {a} flooded, unless both adjust.
moonElements.Water|Water: Both Moons are in water: emotional understanding is immediate and deep. A strongly sympathetic bond that benefits from some outside air.

_overlays_comment: One person's Sun, Moon, Venus or Mars falling in a house of the other's chart. overlayHouses is keyed by house number; {guest} owns the planet, {host} owns the house, and {brings} is filled from overlayPlanets (several planets in one house are read together: 'warmth, affection and drive').

overlayHouses.1: {guest} brings {brings} straight into {host}'s sense of self. {host} feels noticed and personally affected by {guest}, and tends to identify with {guest}.
overlayHouses.2: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of money and self-worth: {guest} affects how secure and valued {host} feels, and practical or financial matters are part of the tie.
overlayHouses.3: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of communication: talk, messages and everyday errands are where {host} feels {guest} most.
overlayHouses.4: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of home and family. {guest} feels like home to {host}: familiar, private, and close to the roots.
overlayHouses.5: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of romance, play and creativity: {host} has fun with {guest} and feels more spontaneous.
overlayHouses.6: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of work and routine: the tie shows in daily habits, shared tasks and being useful to each other.
overlayHouses.7: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of partnership. {host} readily sees {guest} as a partner and an equal; one of the most telling placements for commitment.
overlayHouses.8: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of intimacy and shared resources: the connection goes deep for {host}, touching trust, privacy and change.
overlayHouses.9: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of travel, study and belief: {guest} broadens {host}'s horizons and makes {host} think bigger.
overlayHouses.10: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of career and reputation: {guest} influences {host}'s ambitions and public standing, and {host} may look up to {guest}.
overlayHouses.11: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of friends and hopes: friendship is the foundation, and {guest} supports what {host} is aiming for.
overlayHouses.12: {guest} brings {brings} to {host}'s house of solitude and the hidden side of life: {guest} touches what {host} keeps private. A quiet bond, sometimes hard to explain.

houses.12: solitude, rest and the hidden side of life

tones.Soulmates: The contacts between these two charts are overwhelmingly easy ones, and there are plenty of them. Few pairs of charts fit together this smoothly: what one reaches for, the other tends to offer.
tones.Adversaries: The contacts between these two charts are dominated by the difficult aspects. Few pairs of charts rub against each other this much. It describes friction, rivalry and strong reactions, which can bind two people as surely as ease does, but rarely comfortably.
tones.Harmonious: Taken together, the contacts between these two charts are easier than most: there is more that flows than that grates.
tones.Mixed: The contacts between these two charts are a fairly even mix of easy and difficult: attraction and friction in about equal measure, which is the usual case for people who matter to each other.
tones.Challenging: The contacts between these two charts include more of the difficult aspects than most pairs have. That means intensity and friction rather than incompatibility: these charts push each other.
tones.Light: Few close contacts link these two charts. In astrological terms the connection is a light one.

notes.davison: The Davison chart is cast for the moment halfway between the two births, at the place halfway between the two birthplaces. Unlike the comparison above, which sets one chart against the other, it is a single real chart, and astrologers read it as the chart of the relationship itself.
notes.davisonPointer: The Davison chart has a reading, a wheel and a worksheet of its own: choose Davison chart at the top of the Synastry view.
notes.unknownBirthTimeOne: {name} has no recorded birth time, so that chart's Ascendant, Midheaven, houses and Moon are left out of the comparison.
notes.unknownBirthTimeBoth: Neither chart has a recorded birth time, so the Ascendants, Midheavens, houses and Moons are left out of the comparison.
